offences.quote: You submit Gen AI content in an assessment as if it is your own work (undeclared use of Gen AI)
Misrepresenting AI-generated work as your own is academic misconduct and may result in an academic integrity investigation.
You declare your use of Gen AI, but the Gen AI content replaces the learning, thinking or skills that the assessment is designed to assess (declared, but inappropriate use of Gen AI)
You may not upload teaching materials, such as lecture slides, lecture recordings or assessment briefs, to Gen AI tools unless you have your module leader’s permission to do so.
Outputs from Gen AI will constitute plagiarism, even where it is not directly copied.
offences.anchor: What about Postgraduate Research and Generative AI?

process.quote: Misrepresenting AI-generated work as your own is academic misconduct and may result in an academic integrity investigation.
If a concern is raised about the Academic Integrity of your work, you will have an opportunity to explain and provide evidence.
